array.string: CFG="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cursor-ollama-gateway"; LOGROOT="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/cursor-ollama-gateway/logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGROOT"; exec >>"$LOGROOT/ollama.out.log" 2>&1; source "$CFG/.env" && export OLLAMA_HOST="${OLLAMA_HOST:-127.0.0.1:11434}" && exec "$(command -v ollama)" serve
